description:
Maven plugin for Java and Scala pipelines.

    CURRENT STATUS: PLACEHOLDER. The single MutateMojo throws
    MojoExecutionException. The Java/Scala orchestration described in
    ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.4 (test-classpath introspection, matching
    shim resolution via Aether, Surefire/Failsafe argLine injection, and the
    baseline/mutation loop) is NOT implemented.

    The module exists so that:
      1. the full reactor builds and installs cleanly, and
      2. the artifact coordinate io.github.wpunit13:spark-mutation-testing-maven-plugin
         quoted in the project README actually resolves.

    Use the pytest-spark-mutation-testing Python plugin for PySpark pipelines; that
    track is complete.
